verdict.rationale: Tuning index parameters is a fair axis for a vector database, but the evidence pack never documents user-configurable HNSW settings or selectable index types. The docs only say Chroma handles indexing automatically, and the community note about SPANN/SPFresh indexes on Chroma Cloud describes the backend, not a tuning control.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can tune index parameters (HNSW graph settings, index types) to trade recall against latency and memory
